map.!type: fn(collection: ?, iteratee: fn(value: ?, index: number, collection: ?) -> ?) -> [?]
map.!doc: Creates an array of values by running each element in collection thru iteratee

filter.!type: fn(collection: ?, predicate: fn(value: ?, index: number, collection: ?) -> bool) -> [?]
filter.!doc: Iterates over elements of collection, returning an array of all elements predicate returns truthy for

find.!type: fn(collection: ?, predicate: fn(value: ?, index: number, collection: ?) -> bool, fromIndex?: number) -> ?
find.!doc: Iterates over elements of collection, returning the first element predicate returns truthy for

reduce.!type: fn(collection: ?, iteratee: fn(accumulator: ?, value: ?, index: number, collection: ?) -> ?, accumulator?: ?) -> ?
reduce.!doc: Reduces collection to a value which is the accumulated result of running each element

each.!type: fn(collection: ?, iteratee: fn(value: ?, index: number, collection: ?)) -> ?
each.!doc: Iterates over elements of collection and invokes iteratee for each element

forEach.!type: fn(collection: ?, iteratee: fn(value: ?, index: number, collection: ?)) -> ?
forEach.!doc: Iterates over elements of collection and invokes iteratee for each element

includes.!doc: Checks if value is in collection

orderBy.!doc: This method is like _.sortBy except that it allows specifying the sort orders

sortBy.!doc: Creates an array of elements, sorted in ascending order by the results of running each element

groupBy.!doc: Creates an object composed of keys generated from the results of running each element

countBy.!doc: Creates an object composed of keys generated from the results of running each element

keyBy.!doc: Creates an object composed of keys generated from the results of running each element

isEmpty.!doc: Checks if value is an empty object, collection, map, or set

isArray.!doc: Checks if value is classified as an Array object

isObject.!doc: Checks if value is the language type of Object

isString.!doc: Checks if value is classified as a String primitive or object

isNumber.!doc: Checks if value is classified as a Number primitive or object

isBoolean.!doc: Checks if value is classified as a boolean primitive

isFunction.!doc: Checks if value is classified as a Function object

isEqual.!doc: Performs a deep comparison between two values to determine if they are equivalent

get.!doc: Gets the value at path of object

set.!doc: Sets the value at path of object

assign.!doc: Assigns own enumerable string keyed properties of source objects to the destination object

merge.!doc: Recursively merges own and inherited enumerable string keyed properties of source objects

pick.!doc: Creates an object composed of the picked object properties

omit.!doc: The opposite of _.pick; this method creates an object composed of the own and inherited enumerable

keys.!doc: Creates an array of the own enumerable property names of object

values.!doc: Creates an array of the own enumerable string keyed property values of object

entries.!doc: Creates an array of own enumerable string keyed-value pairs for object

range.!type: fn(start?: number, end?: number, step?: number) -> [?]
range.!doc: Creates an array of numbers (positive and/or negative) progressing from start

times.!doc: Invokes the iteratee n times, returning an array of the results

random.!type: fn(min?: number, max?: number, floating?: bool) -> number
random.!doc: Produces a random number between min and max (inclusive)

now.!doc: Gets the timestamp of the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since the Unix epoch

debounce.!type: fn(func: fn() -> ?, wait?: number, options?: ?) -> fn() -> ?
debounce.!doc: Creates a debounced function that delays invoking func until after wait milliseconds

throttle.!type: fn(func: fn() -> ?, wait?: number, options?: ?) -> fn() -> ?
throttle.!doc: Creates a throttled function that only invokes func at most once per every wait milliseconds

clone.!doc: Creates a shallow clone of value

cloneDeep.!doc: This method is like _.clone except that it recursively clones value

chunk.!doc: Creates an array of elements split into groups the length of size

compact.!doc: Creates an array with all falsey values removed

concat.!doc: Creates a new array concatenating array with any additional arrays and/or values

difference.!doc: Creates an array of array values not included in the other given arrays

union.!doc: Creates an array of unique values, in order, from all given arrays

uniq.!doc: Creates a duplicate-free version of an array

head.!doc: Gets the first element of array

last.!doc: Gets the last element of array

initial.!doc: Gets all but the last element of array

tail.!doc: Gets all but the first element of array

take.!doc: Creates a slice of array with n elements taken from the beginning

takeRight.!doc: Creates a slice of array with n elements taken from the end

drop.!doc: Creates a slice of array with n elements dropped from the beginning

dropRight.!doc: Creates a slice of array with n elements dropped from the end

flatten.!doc: Flattens array a single level deep

fromPairs.!doc: The inverse of _.toPairs; this method returns an object composed from key-value pairs

toPairs.!doc: Creates an array of own enumerable string keyed-value pairs for object

capitalize.!doc: Converts the first character of string to upper case and the remaining to lower case

lowerCase.!doc: Converts string, as space separated words, to lower case

upperCase.!doc: Converts string, as space separated words, to upper case

trim.!doc: Removes leading and trailing whitespace or specified characters from string

escape.!doc: Converts the characters &, <, >, ", and ' in string to their corresponding HTML entities

unescape.!doc: The inverse of _.escape; this method converts the HTML entities &, <, >, ", and '
